title: Nvidia Donates $250M to UK AI Agent Safety Research
summary:
Imperial College London and other research centers will gain $50 million per year in specialized computing power from Nvidia to test the resilience of autonomous AI software. The $250 million total commitment over five years will support work at BOLD at the University of Oxford and SOFAIR at UCL, focusing on AI agent safety and the development of security safeguards as capabilities expand.

The infrastructure for this initiative will be hosted within the UK via local cloud partners to support a domestic research ecosystem. Separately, Nvidia is joining The Earthshot Prize as a Global Alliance Founding Partner to provide technical expertise for climate and sustainability projects ahead of the GTC Berlin event.
